palindrome:
Creating a palindrome that is at least 255 characters long is quite an undertaking! Here's one example:

```
A man, a plan, a canal: Panama madam, in Eden, I'm Adam
Able was I ere I saw Elba
No 'x' in Nixon
Sue, Dad, I'm Eve
Was it a car or a cat I saw?
Race car
Step on no pets
God is good
Madam In Eden, I'm Adam
Level
Dad, I'm Adam
Able was I ere I saw Elba
Eve
```

These phrases are already palindromes when read normally. If you want a single long palindrome consisting of repeated words or patterns, it would look much longer:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba Able was I ere I saw Elba Able was I ere I saw Elba ...
```

This example repeats the phrase "Able was I ere I saw Elba" over and over to create a very long palindrome. You can repeat it enough times to exceed 255 characters.
